limitations: Read microbenchmarks repeat one record inside one database operation.
Write microbenchmarks use distinct IDs inside one transaction, excluding standalone commit latency.
Retained bulk comparisons are sequential mutations with overlapping ID ranges, not byte-identical A/B replays.
No physical reboot or 100-million-body acceptance in this phase.
Source replacement still owns a long writer transaction; admission and final search validation can wait for that writer.
